calibration.method: min micro mean NLL over a 121-point log grid 0.25..4.0
calibration.logits: selected run at T=1, packed form, bf16 autocast over float32 base weights
calibration.selected_dev_metric: source_language_macro_record_nll on the fixed development sample

conditions.fp32_tolerance_justification: fp32 gate 3e-5: on inputs of ~1,000+ tokens each fp32 path sits up to 1.2e-5 from an fp64 reference (fp64 packed vs rows agree to 2.7e-7), so fp32 paths differ by up to 2e-5 from rounding, not logic

merged_fp32_vs_reloaded.note: fp32 -> deployed-dtype arithmetic difference; measured, not a tolerance

limitations: Italian is synthetic and only a limited semantic sample was reviewed
All source rows considered, then deduplication, holdout and quality filters; original source-label noise remains
Single seed; no claim of causal comparison with larger released Kev backbones
Final tests use the exported BF16 artifact; no test-based checkpoint or temperature selection
